game.name: vanilla-wow

global.value: The v1 Vanilla WoW Coworld does not stream gameplay over /global. During a running episode, /client/global and WS /global expose one read-only vanilla_wow.episode_watch.v1 progress projection from the player metrics already forwarded over authenticated sessions; add format=json to the HTTP route for structured tooling.

player.value: Players connect to the exact runner-provided COWORLD_PLAYER_WS_URL at WS /player?slot=<slot>&token=<token>. WebSocket subprotocol vanilla-wow-policy selects binary vanilla_wow.control_wire Observation/Action traffic without rewriting the URL. Omitting the subprotocol selects the native/rendered session handoff used by RealPlayerBot, with account credentials, authenticated realmd and mangosd bridges, navigation, and immutable world-asset paths. During migration the game emits vanilla_wow.session.v1; current players accept both that literal and vanilla_wow.session and reply with the received literal so .v1 can be removed after active player images roll forward. Current players send typed status, route, or local_graph navigation requests on that retained authenticated session; already-published players may negotiate the legacy navigation extension and POST the same typed requests to /player/navigation. Players fetch only referenced DBFilesClient, Maps, VMaps, or MMaps files beneath /player/assets using the same slot token. Navigation responses are read-only evidence; policies still move through ordinary Action client input and server-validated movement. Human native and browser/WASM Nim players use the authenticated /client/player handoff; no separate mutable browser bot console exists.

game.description: Isolated Vanilla WoW episodes for 10x leveling, Kalimdor racing, RFC dungeon clears, and Arena 2v2, with one VMaNGOS backend per episode and independent leagues bound to explicit variants.

BagItemSpec.title: BagItemSpec
BagItemSpec.description:
One stack to place in the seeded character's backpack.

Fixture variants (mail/auction/trade provisioning) use these so client-path
service commands have items to attach, list, and trade.

TowerConfig.title: TowerConfig
TowerConfig.description: Configuration for the generated dungeon-climb mode.

StartPosition.title: StartPosition
StartPosition.description: World location a seeded character is placed at on first login.

PetFixtureSpec.title: PetFixtureSpec
PetFixtureSpec.description: Minimal persisted hunter pet row for stable fixture readiness.

RfcRoundConfig.title: RfcRoundConfig
RfcRoundConfig.description: One normalized, disposable Dungeon Wow RFC launch.

SpellLabConfig.title: SpellLabConfig
SpellLabConfig.description:
Optional deterministic spell-effect lab staging.

The lab writes world rows before VMaNGOS starts so live testing still casts
through the normal realmd/world client path. ``bindings`` maps an account
username to that character's staged action buttons; when absent, the legacy
single ``spell_id``/``action_button`` pair applies to every lab character.

ClassDeckConfig.title: ClassDeckConfig
ClassDeckConfig.description: Optional server-authoritative class spell draft progression.

QuestStatusSpec.title: QuestStatusSpec
QuestStatusSpec.description: One durable quest-log row for proof-realm fixture readiness.

SpellLabBinding.title: SpellLabBinding
SpellLabBinding.description: One staged action-button assignment for a lab character.

CoworldStateSpec.title: CoworldStateSpec
CoworldStateSpec.description: Game-agnostic state intent attached to a Coworld episode.

DungeonLabConfig.title: DungeonLabConfig
DungeonLabConfig.description:
Optional Dungeon Lab scenario staging.

``definition_path`` names a ``coworld.dungeon`` document (the manifest
convention is a repo-relative ``content/dungeons/<name>.dungeon.json``). The
runtime compiles it to a world overlay before VMaNGOS starts and stages
the seeded party at the definition's entrance.

SkillFixtureSpec.title: SkillFixtureSpec
SkillFixtureSpec.description: A skill row intentionally left below cap for live skill-up proofs.

ActionBarSlotSpec.title: ActionBarSlotSpec
ActionBarSlotSpec.description: One deterministic action-bar binding for a seeded character.

CharacterSeedSpec.title: CharacterSeedSpec
CharacterSeedSpec.description:
Per-player character to write into the VMaNGOS DB before the session.

When a player carries this block the runtime seeds a level-set, geared
character on that player's provisioned account so the player logs straight
into a ready character instead of the character-creation screen. The
default profile uses VMaNGOS premade templates; ``playercreateinfo`` uses
stock starter gear, spells, actions, and spawn rows for low-level fixtures.

CorpseFixtureSpec.title: CorpseFixtureSpec
CorpseFixtureSpec.description: A corpse row paired with a character for corpse-run fixture readiness.

WorldSnapshotSpec.title: WorldSnapshotSpec
WorldSnapshotSpec.description: Private signed full-world artifact restored before an isolated realm starts.

RosterSnapshotSpec.title: RosterSnapshotSpec
RosterSnapshotSpec.description: Private signed character-copy artifact imported into an isolated realm.

PetSpellFixtureSpec.title: PetSpellFixtureSpec
PetSpellFixtureSpec.description: One persisted pet spell using stock VMaNGOS pet-action state values.

EquippedItemSeedSpec.title: EquippedItemSeedSpec
EquippedItemSeedSpec.description: One explicit equipped item for a normalized seeded loadout.

InitialCharacterSpec.title: InitialCharacterSpec
InitialCharacterSpec.description:
Submitted identity preference for an account's first character.

Every stock-playable Vanilla race/class combination is available. Consumers
may create the character through the ordinary client or materialize a
normalized league fixture from the same identity.

CharacterCreationSpec.title: CharacterCreationSpec
CharacterCreationSpec.description: Character identity created through the ordinary Vanilla client path.

EpisodeCompletionSpec.title: EpisodeCompletionSpec
EpisodeCompletionSpec.description:
Authoritative conditions that end an otherwise long-running episode.

An empty specification completes when every expected player is online.

KalimdorTraversalSpec.title: KalimdorTraversalSpec
KalimdorTraversalSpec.description:
Fixed south-to-north Kalimdor scoring boundary and Everlook goal.

The stock minimap projects geographic north/south from VMaNGOS world X,
so northing is deliberately derived from world X rather than world Y.
Goal completion is a three-dimensional radius around the terrain-verified
Everlook anchor rather than the old world-X finish line.

PersistentEntrantSpec.title: PersistentEntrantSpec
PersistentEntrantSpec.description: Stable account owner authored by the league Commissioner.

PersistentGatewaySpec.title: PersistentGatewaySpec
PersistentGatewaySpec.description: Private gateway connection injected through a Coworld config overlay.

LeagueEntrantPreferences.title: LeagueEntrantPreferences
LeagueEntrantPreferences.description: Typed membership preferences projected into one scheduled player seat.

DungeonLabDifficultyOverride.title: DungeonLabDifficultyOverride
DungeonLabDifficultyOverride.description:
Per-variant difficulty overrides layered over a dungeon definition.

Any field left ``None`` keeps the definition's own ``difficulty`` value.
Bounds mirror ``dungeon.DifficultyMultipliers`` (the compiler clamps
shifted clone levels into 1..63).

league_preferences.title: League Preferences
league_preferences.description: Membership preferences aligned with policy seats by the platform commissioner.

scores.description: One score per player slot. Leveling episodes use level + XP / XP required for the next level; Kalimdor traversal uses authoritative mainland northing yards from the fixed southern origin; RFC speedruns use lower-is-better elapsed minutes (authoritative clear time, or 60.0 for a failed, timed-out, or otherwise unverified clear); Arena 2v2 uses the number of distinct opposing players eliminated by the slot's team; other dungeon variants use their objective score.

grader.name: Vanilla WoW RFC Completion Grader
grader.description: Grades an RFC episode from 0 to 1 by the fraction of four boss objectives completed and preserves full-clear time as provenance.

player.name: RealPlayerBot
player.description: Renderer-backed computer-use player. The canonical Observation combines semantic client truth with optional UI, scene, depth, and ground presentation; read-only navigation may guide input Actions through ordinary keyboard and mouse execution. The image keeps only the small UI atlas and streams render assets on demand.

variants.name: Custom Fresh Start 10x Time
variants.description: A fresh account on which the submitted player creates and selects a character through the ordinary Vanilla client flow, using its submitted initial race/class/gender when present. It runs for 720 wall seconds with the VMaNGOS gameplay clock accelerated 10x while XP, rest, money, and item-drop rates remain stock. This provides about two simulated hours in 12 minutes and ranks fresh-start episodes independently from Persistent Leveling.

variants.name: Kalimdor Race 10x Time
variants.description: One isolated level-60 character starts at a terrain-verified southern Tanaris anchor and has 270 wall seconds at 10x gameplay speed to traverse mainland Kalimdor to within 300 yards of Everlook, preserving the prior 45 simulated-minute horizon. Entrants may choose a valid Horde race, class, and gender; the default is a tauren druid. The account has no seeded flight paths, mount items, riding or mount spells, teleport items, money, or league-authored action-bar layout. Every policy receives the canonical Observation and emits an Action; RealPlayerBot uses the optional presentation to choose ordinary client input validated by VMaNGOS. The final authoritative server position scores mainland northing yards, capped at Everlook; reaching the goal requires entering the encoded three-dimensional Everlook radius.

variants.name: RFC Four-Player Clear
variants.description: A complete RFC party has one tank, one healer, and two DPS seats on normalized game-owned characters selected from each assigned policy's submitted tank, healer, and DPS profiles. The legacy variant ID is retained for deployed-league compatibility.

variants.name: Arena 2v2
variants.description: Two entrants each control a configurable two-character team in a level-60 elimination match bounded to ten minutes of in-game time in the outdoor Ruins of Lordaeron above Undercity. The default fixture is Fury Warrior plus Shadow Priest, while the Arena commissioner may overlay any two supported normalized profiles per entrant. A team wins when both opponents have died; defeated seats remain dead until teardown, and every slot receives its team's authoritative elimination score.

diagnoser.name: Vanilla WoW RFC Diagnoser
diagnoser.description: Produces deterministic policy-facing findings for missing RFC bosses, deaths, clear time, and god-view evidence coverage.

optimizer.name: Vanilla WoW RFC Optimizer Seed
optimizer.description: Creates an RFC-specific policy-improvement plan from available report, grade, and diagnosis artifacts.
